correctness.rationale: The degree-12 discriminant pulls back under the quadratic parameter to degree 24, with generic simple nodal fibers by jet surjectivity and Bertini. Single and ordered-pair node incidences are irreducible vector bundles because one- and two-point evaluations of binary quadratics surject onto cubic coefficient spaces; hence the degree-24 cover is 2-transitive. A single nodal cubic with zero first base derivative has critical-value unfolding eps+kappa*tau^2, kappa nonzero, giving one simple transposition. Therefore the monodromy and generic Galois groups are exactly S24. The verified rank-two lattice has primitive isotropic classes pairing divisibly by three, and the geometric double-plane involution exchanges the pencils. The symbolic diagnostic verifies only supporting identities, not the geometric proofs.

originality.rationale: The source establishes the K3 model, Picard lattice and two fibration rays but not the full S_24 permutation group of the 24 exceptional parameters. Zhan proves S_24 for genus-one Weierstrass K3s WITH a section; those families are not this quadratic ternary-cubic restricted family with index three and no section. Classical enumerative monodromy methods are acknowledged; a family-specific two-point irreducibility and transposition construction is supplied. Public semantic searches and inspected published statements did not reveal an equivalent or stronger statement. Old unindexed sources remain a priority risk.

value.rationale: The exact Galois group of the natural singular-parameter cover for the constrained 30-coefficient quadratic ternary-cubic K3 family is a structural invariant not determined by its 24-fold degree. It proves maximal arithmetic ambiguity of degeneration parameters despite special period-three torsor geometry and simultaneously controls both involution-conjugate genus-one pencils. This connects newly described cubic/Verra fourfold K3 geometry with explicit Galois and degeneration data rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
